criterion: which domain of everyday assistant use the utterance belongs to

categories.name: Alarms & Timers
categories.definition: Setting, checking, or managing alarms, timers, or general time-based reminders.

categories.name: Calendar & Scheduling
categories.definition: Managing events, appointments, meetings, or schedules, including event-specific reminders.

categories.name: Communication
categories.definition: Sending or receiving messages (email, text, calls) or managing contacts.

categories.name: Conversational & Assistant Persona
categories.definition: Utterances related to general conversation, jokes, assistant's persona, or feedback about the assistant's performance.

categories.name: Device Control & Settings
categories.definition: Controlling smart home devices, media playback settings (volume, mute), or general device functions.

categories.name: Entertainment & Media Playback
categories.definition: Playing music, podcasts, audiobooks, radio, or games; includes controls like play/pause/skip.

categories.name: Information & General Knowledge
categories.definition: Asking factual questions, definitions, calculations, or seeking general advice not covered by other specific domains.

categories.name: Lists & Notes
categories.definition: Creating, managing, or retrieving various types of lists (shopping, to-do, general notes).

categories.name: Local Search & Events
categories.definition: Finding places, businesses, or local events nearby.

categories.name: News
categories.definition: Retrieving current events, headlines, or specific news topics.

categories.name: Personal Data & Assistant Memory
categories.definition: Retrieving or managing personal information, user preferences, or past interactions stored by the assistant.

categories.name: Shopping & Ordering
categories.definition: Purchasing items, ordering food, or tracking orders.

categories.name: Social Media
categories.definition: Interacting with social media platforms (posting, checking notifications).

categories.name: Travel & Transportation
categories.definition: Booking travel, requesting ride-hailing services, or seeking information about public or private transportation.

categories.name: Weather
categories.definition: Asking for current weather, forecasts, or weather-related advice.
